description: Route-test fixture, applied on top of data/airports/TEST.json: the two connectors from B down to E (edges bE1-eW, named E1, and bE2-eE, named E2) are renamed E. Taxiway E then meets B at both ends, at bE1 and at bE2, so 'B then E' to the penalty box works both ways round the loop: from D, a turn onto B with no direction is ambiguous. In TEST itself it isn't, because E1 and E2 are separate taxiways the route has to name.
